Overview

Denpasar is a city in Bali with a population of 725,000. The capital of Bali, a bustling gateway to the Island of the Gods known for its vibrant markets, cultural landmarks, and proximity to world-famous beaches. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
